title: Delete DeprecationHelper and DeprecationHelperTests
description: Delete DeprecationHelper.cs (src/ZapiCli/Commands/DeprecationHelper.cs) and its corresponding test file (tests/ZapiCli.Tests/DeprecationHelperTests.cs). By the time this story runs, Story 38 will have removed all DeprecationHelper.Warn() call sites, leaving DeprecationHelper as pure dead infrastructure. This is Phase 3 of the remove-deprecated-commands-1 plan.
prerequisiteState: Story 38 is complete. All deprecated shim classes have been deleted. No file in src/ contains a call to DeprecationHelper.Warn(). DeprecationHelper.cs exists but has zero callers.
goal: After this story: DeprecationHelper.cs does not exist in the repository. DeprecationHelperTests.cs does not exist in the repository. dotnet build and dotnet test both pass with 0 errors.
scope: Before deleting, run a grep across src/ for 'DeprecationHelper.Warn(' to confirm zero results. If any callers remain, stop and investigate — Story 38 may be incomplete.
Scan all remaining *.cs files in src/ and tests/ for any residual 'using' directive or reference to 'DeprecationHelper'. If found, remove the reference.
Run 'dotnet build src/zapi-cli.sln' — must exit 0 with 0 errors.
Run 'dotnet test src/zapi-cli.sln' — all tests must pass.
acceptanceCriteria: dotnet build src/zapi-cli.sln exits 0 with no errors
dotnet test src/zapi-cli.sln exits 0 with all tests passing
contextForAgent: DeprecationHelper is a small internal static class with a single Warn() method that writes to stderr. It lives in src/ZapiCli/Commands/DeprecationHelper.cs. Its only purpose was to support the deprecated command shims deleted in Story 38. The test file DeprecationHelperTests.cs tests only the Warn() behavior — those tests have no value once the helper is gone. There should be no other file that imports or references DeprecationHelper after Story 38.
